brain_intelligence_guidelines.title: Domain H — Technical Construction: Zero-Latency Client-Side Canvas & WebAssembly Ingestion
brain_intelligence_guidelines.invariant: Client-side file transformation pipelines must ingest files via Blob.arrayBuffer(), parse MIME-types strictly in memory, and transcode using OffscreenCanvas or WebAssembly workers without freezing the main UI thread. All allocations must be revoked via URL.revokeObjectURL().

tasks.title: Implement core storage engine and deterministic data models for IncidentLens
tasks.description: Construct atomic file storage, JSON serialization routines, schema validation logic, and query filters.
tasks.objective: Deliver robust, crash-resilient storage engine without external database dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: Atomic file write succeeds and persists data across reloads
Schema validation enforces required attributes and rejects malformed inputs

tasks.title: Build HTTP server, REST endpoints, and RFC 7807 error middleware for IncidentLens
tasks.description: Implement native Node.js HTTP server, REST route handlers, query parameter filtering, and RFC 7807 problem details responses.
tasks.objective: Deliver production-grade, self-contained REST HTTP service.
acceptance_criteria: REST API endpoints return correct HTTP status codes (200, 201, 400, 404)
Error responses strictly adhere to RFC 7807 (type, title, status, detail, instance)
CORS and security headers (nosniff, DENY) applied on all responses

tasks.title: Assemble accessible WCAG AA dashboard UI and client controller for IncidentLens
tasks.description: Construct self-contained dashboard HTML, high-contrast CSS design tokens, and reactive client controller.
tasks.objective: Deliver accessible, zero-network user interface embedded in the server.
acceptance_criteria: Zero external CDN scripts or stylesheet dependencies
Live forms interact seamlessly with REST API endpoints
